scope: Typed first-party prelaunch refusal may release only a paused local sequencer after original native work and process-reference checks.

negative_cases: launch_uncertain numeric zero rather than literal False
boolean API counter rather than integer zero
same-bundle process reference appears during native inspection

source_review: Shared predicate preserves all prior typed envelope/bundle/fingerprint/attempt/zero-write gates and adds exact current intent profile and original three-code whitelist. The initial receiver still also matches actual raised error code.

Abandon exception applies only to no run_id, literal launch_uncertain False, complete exact current no-start proof, and no original matching references. It cannot replace process evidence when a reference exists.
Original full selected namespace reads occur before and after native work inspection while holding original start/control lock.
Every original scope must still contain nonempty known work states limited to pending/failed/result_ready/delivered. Unknown/leased/incomplete work does not release the batch.
Old proof is still cleared before a later new launch intent. Abandon preserves entries, work, receipts, fees and failed results, grants no dispatch authority, and does not retry any HTTP.

Current blocked reasons need not equal historical prelaunch code because later read-only native inspections may legitimately change those reasons without another launch. Exact nonce/profile remain the original source binding.

Final _step receiver requires an actual string error.code before passing it to the shared predicate. The predicate None default remains an intentional omission only for reading persisted no-start control evidence during abandonment.
author_reported_validation: Prior relevant author cohort24P; later code-less receiver closure author25P. Separate pins/cohorts, not a claimed combined final run.
limits: Original executor process/native work inspection is a deterministic isolated fake; this is engineering acceptance of gateway boundaries, not a claim that the real paused batch has been abandoned.
No real fees, company answers, database rows, owner controls or running services were changed.

cases: Original genuine positive typed no-start proof still permits only local batch abandonment.
A code-less generic error cannot borrow a complete positive typed proof from another error; proof is asserted non-null and exact nonce-bound before consumer rejection.

closed_findings.resolution: Initial consumer requires actual string error.code, so optional code=None cannot skip actual raised-code matching.
